1. Compute the local mean and standard deviation with running sums of the values and their squares.
2. Find the smallest value M of the image and the largest standard deviation R.
3. Set the threshold to (1 - k) m + k M + k (s / R) (m - M).
4. Compare each pixel with its own threshold.
